ops.body:
## Resolution

Accepted the map's recommended five fixed Zones (demo preference: prefer agent recommendations).

| City label | IANA timezone |
|---|---|
| London | `Europe/London` |
| New York | `America/New_York` |
| Los Angeles | `America/Los_Angeles` |
| Tokyo | `Asia/Tokyo` |
| Sydney | `Australia/Sydney` |

Zone labels are **city only** (not city + region). That clears the map fog item about Zone label copy tone.

No new tickets. No scope changes.

ops.comment: Resolved: five fixed Zones locked (see resolution comment).
